narrative: A speech of four lines, then the pen striking through every one of them. The sheet from the morning is the same sheet. The four lines sit struck through. One short line stands under the stroke, unstruck. The tables at the edge of the board still show the three words.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Struck the long greeting and wrote the short line.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in One speech struck shorter
